user.title: Automation Backtest
user.description: Adds the 'Backtest automation' and 'Compare automations' actions. Nothing is ever executed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Automation Backtest is already set up.

run.name: Backtest automation
run.description: Replay an automation over recorded history and report when it would have run, and which condition blocked it otherwise. Actions are never executed.

config.name: Configuration
config.description: Automation YAML (triggers + conditions) to test instead of an existing automation.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back from 'end' (ignored when 'start' is set).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the window (local time). Defaults to now.

include_runs.name: Include runs
include_runs.description: Include full per-run details with condition traces.

max_runs.name: Max runs
max_runs.description: Limit the number of runs returned.

skip_conditions.name: Skip conditions
skip_conditions.description: Condition paths to treat as disabled for this backtest only (as shown in the results, e.g. condition/0 or action/2/if/0). The automation is not changed.

compare.name: Compare automations
compare.description: Backtest two versions over the same window and show which runs only happen in one of them.

config.name: Configuration
config.description: Version A as YAML, instead of an existing automation.

config_b.name: Version B
config_b.description: The edited automation YAML to compare against.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back from 'end' (ignored when 'start' is set).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the window (local time). Defaults to now.

skip_conditions.name: Skip conditions
skip_conditions.description: Condition paths to treat as disabled in both versions for this comparison only.
